restrictions: ONE EMULATED SYSTEM, ONE ABI: the APK (minSdk 24, targetSdk 37) was run only on an Android 7.0 (API 24) x86_64 emulator (Android emulator 37.2.13.0, AVD API24, system image android-24 default x86_64 revision 8, 1,536 MB, WHPX, headless with swiftshader_indirect): not a phone, no real GPU, touch screen, vendor skin, vendor fonts or input method. display_ms (243 to 463 ms over 6 default runs, median 303.5) and peak_rss_kb (68,616 to 69,060) are the emulator's and indicative only. No other API level (25 to 37) was started, so nothing is known about Android 8 to 16.

ONLY THE x86_64 LIBRARY WAS EXECUTED: the same APK holds armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a and x86 libraries, built and statically checked by tools/build.py (needed libraries libc, libm, libdl only; only the 6 Java_fr_bansan_loomora_probe_Native_* functions exported; LOAD segments aligned to 16 KB; the backend and the glue compiled with -std=c++11) but never run. No ARM system or device was available, so no ARM ABI was executed and they are not_tested; the x86 library was not run either (no 32-bit x86 Modern system).

NO ANDROID 14+ PATH EXERCISED: the only API above level 24 the UI calls is UiModeManager.getContrast() (level 34), behind Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34 (fallback android-uimode-contrast in validation/fallbacks.json). On this API 24 system the check is false, the standard Material 3 scheme is used and the probe lines carry disabled_features ["uimode-contrast"]. The high contrast path (API 34 or later with a high contrast level) was never run, and neither was the edge-to-edge behaviour enforced from targetSdk 35 on a system that enforces it (API 35+): on API 24 the window insets are applied by Compose and the screenshots show the banner below the status bar.

THEMES: the dark theme and high contrast were NOT checked on a screen. The UI follows isSystemInDarkTheme() with the Material 3 dark scheme, and the window background of values-night/themes.xml, but the dark setting was not turned on (no `cmd uimode` on API 24) and no contrast ratio was measured: the 4.5:1 claim rests on the colour pairs (Material 3 text roles above 12:1, the banner fixed black on #FFF3CD, the high contrast schemes 21:1), not on a measurement of rendered pixels. The two screenshots are the light theme only.

INPUT WAS SYNTHETIC: the window run typed 'Marie' with `adb shell input keyevent` / `input text` and read the screen with uiautomator (typing-uiautomator.txt), never a person, a hardware keyboard or a vendor input method. The update delay of the greeting (User Story 1, within 1 second) was not measured (a 2 s wait before the dump). The 1,000-code-point limit was exercised through the probe input only (the two vectors of more than 1,000 characters were cut to 1,000 code points), not by typing 1,001 characters or pasting.

TEXT GIVEN BY TWO ROUTES: the plain intent extra probe_input for the texts the `am` command can carry, and probe_input_file (a UTF-8 file pushed with adb) for a text with a character outside the BMP or longer than 1,500 bytes, the same launcher as the Legacy UI. Both routes reach the same initial state of the Compose text field; the emoji vectors passed through the file route only.

GLYPHS: the probe checks the greeting text for character for the 15 vectors (CJK, Arabic, Hebrew, emoji, ZWJ sequence); the pixels were looked at for one mixed Unicode input only (screenshot-mixed-unicode.png: accent, euro sign, Greek, CJK drawn, no box). Arabic, Hebrew, emoji and combining characters were not looked at on screen. Capital Greek epsilon (U+0395) is drawn like the Latin E, which is what the font does.

NOT CHECKED: rotation (the activity handles it with configChanges and rememberSaveable, never rotated), screen sizes other than 1080x1920 at 420 dpi, accessibility services (TalkBack), a build signed with anything but a throwaway key made by tools/build.py, installation from a store, the behaviour when the process is killed. The exit of the UI is finish() 2 s after the first drawn frame of the greeting; Android keeps the process cached, so 'exit status 0' is not measured, the launcher checks that the activity is no longer resumed and that logcat has no FATAL EXCEPTION.

THE BUILD IS PINNED AND RECORDED, NOT AUDITED: AGP 9.5.1, Gradle 9.9.1, Kotlin 2.3.21, Compose BOM 2026.09.00, activity-compose 1.13.0, JDK Temurin 25.0.4 (Gradle ran on it as is), NDK r30 (30.0.16248370), CMake 3.22.1, build-tools 36.0.0. R8 minification and resource shrinking are on for the release APK (1,396,354 bytes; the same sha256 98e42af7... came out of three builds, so the build is reproducible on this machine). The libraries that Compose brings (libandroidx.graphics.path.so, built by Google) are in the APK in the four ABIs and were not inspected beyond their presence.

ONE DAY, ONE MACHINE: runs of 2026-11-15 (UTC 2026-11-14 23:33 to 23:40). The first vector run after the package rename of the same day is the one stored; the Legacy UI, renamed to the package id fr.bansan.loomora.probe in the same change, was rebuilt and its 15 vectors passed again (in the session, not stored, see the notes). The evidence stored for the Legacy verdicts (validation/evidence/android-legacy/) keeps the old package id fr.loomora.probe as history and was not edited.

notes: Verdict of the Android Modern UI (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, JNI glue, C++11 backend) on the x86_64 emulator at API 24, written 2026-11-15 after real runs. STATUS ok_restricted: the greeting 'Bonjour Coucou' / 'Bonjour Marie' is computed by the backend and displayed, typing updates it, the end-of-life banner shows, the 15 reference vectors pass, two screenshots (light theme, default and mixed Unicode) were looked at, but the restrictions above are real: emulator only, API 24 only, x86_64 only, no ARM ABI executed, no dark or high contrast screen, synthetic input. DECISION keep: nothing found makes the UI unusable on this system. Spike S8 (Android half): Compose with the pinned AndroidX versions does not accept minSdk 21 (library minSdk 23), the floor 24 is unchanged. The Legacy UI was renamed to the package id fr.bansan.loomora.probe in the same change and its 15 vectors passed again on this emulator (the Legacy x86 library ran as a 32-bit process, so its probe line reads android-7.0-x86, which has no platform record: not stored). SPEC 002 (.loomora project file), runs of 2026-11-17, recorded 2026-11-18 (this paragraph REPLACES the first version of 2026-11-17, which said not_tested because the NDK and an emulator were not installed; they were installed afterwards, validation/results/spec-002/android_results.md, branch feat/fmt-android). Host: one Windows 11 machine (identified as an Intel Core i7-11800H by the other spec 002 records; android_results.json names no CPU), emulator 37.2.13.0 on WHPX, headless. API 24 (this record): AVD API24 = android-24 default x86_64 revision 8, 1,536 MB. loomora_selftest passed, loomora_format_selftest passed, the S-F1 spike printed 'S-F1: ok' and loomora_refgen wrote six reference files whose SHA-256 are identical to the reference, for the x86_64 build (NDK r15c, android-21 sysroot, PIE, sizeof(void*)=8, LOOMORA_FMT_LSEEK64 off) and for the x86 build run as a 32-bit process (android-16 sysroot, PIE, sizeof(void*)=4, LOOMORA_FMT_LSEEK64 on: API 12 to 20 path); hashes in validation/evidence/adr-0021/android-7.0-x86_64/hashes.json, files not stored again (ADR 0014). The test programs are built with NDK r15c (LOOMORA_ANDROID_PIE, a test-only toolchain parameter, because Android 5.0 and later refuse a non-PIE executable); the Modern UI itself is built with NDK r30 and Gradle. SC-010 (T091): the Modern UI (Kotlin, Compose, JNI bridge) matched `loomora validate --quiet` in 37 of 37 runs (6 references written on the emulator, 9 valid-* files, one invalid file, one missing path, validate_project and roundtrip_project, 3 usage rows) and 116 of 116 on the whole corpus (113 files, validate only); the 15 reference vectors passed (15 passed, 16 skipped, 44.7 s). The Legacy UI (x86 library, 32-bit process, --ui-abi x86) also matched in 37 of 37 and passed 15 vectors on this emulator (outside its range API 9 to 23: see android-7.0-x86_64-legacy.json, not_tested). THE APK OF THIS RUN IS NOT THE ONE OF THE DELIVERABLE RECORD: the Modern APK of 2026-11-17 is 3,388,002 bytes (sha256 20f83ee1fa53759aae91ce64c769c66206640487d70a9fcef14b3e8872b06cd8, 4 ABIs, Gradle 9.9.1 wrapper, AGP 9.5.1, NDK r30, API 24); the deliverable record describes the APK of 2026-11-15 (1,396,354 bytes, sha256 98e42af7...), which was not rewritten (tools/build.py writes it only when the docs submodule is checked out). The Gradle build needed a fix found by this run (LOOMORA_ZLIB_DIR and LOOMORA_RAPIDJSON_DIR set by its CMakeLists because its source directory is not the repository root: build paths, not fallbacks). API 35, A DIFFERENT SYSTEM, NO PLATFORM RECORD (caveat, as for Ubuntu 26.04 against 24.04 in the Linux verdicts): the same x86_64 test programs and the same Modern APK were also run on AVD API35 = android-35 default x86_64 revision 2 (Android 15, plain AOSP image, 2,048 MB, 64-bit ABI only): selftest, format_selftest and S-F1 passed, refgen hashes identical (a separate run in the same hashes.json), the Modern UI passed 15 vectors (50.5 s) and matched in 37 of 37 project-mode runs. tools/run_vectors.py derived the platform id android-15-x86_64, which has no platform record and no verdict: the result is written here, on the nearest record, and is NOT a run on Android 7.0. No platform record for API 35 was created (owner decision needed). Nothing is claimed for the edge-to-edge behaviour, the contrast path or any screen on API 35: no screenshot was taken. The Legacy UI was not run on API 35 (outside its range, and the image has no 32-bit ABI while the Legacy APK has no x86_64 library). NOT RUN and not claimed: the armeabi-v7a and arm64-v8a ABIs (built and ELF-checked only, no ARM system), the Modern UI below API 24 (below its floor), API 25 to 34 (no image installed), Google APIs images, a real phone, files above 2 GiB. The status of this verdict is unchanged.
